verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature, no open export formats, and no account-exit or offboarding flow for Calendly. The REST API's ability to read Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker data is a developer building block, not an export capability. A community report of switching to zcal in 30 minutes is a user-side migration, not a product export feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
